Elodie was born on 3 May 1990 in [Rome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome "Rome"), [Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy "Italy"). She's the daughter of Roberto Di Patrizi, a street artist, and Claudia Marthe, a former model and [go-go dancer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go-go_dancing "Go-go dancing"). Elodie is of [French](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_people "French people")-[Black Creole](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creole_people "Creole people")[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-2) descent from [Guadeloupe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guadeloupe "Guadeloupe"). She has a younger sister, Fey Di Patrizi. In 2008, at age of 18, Elodie auditioned during the casting session of the first season of _[X Factor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X\_Factor\_(Italian\_TV\_series) "X Factor (Italian TV series)")_, being subsequently eliminated during the early stages of the competition.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:0-3)

### 2015–2017: Career beginnings with _Amici di Maria De Filippi_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: 2015–2017: Career beginnings with Amici di Maria De Filippi")]

Main articles: [Amici di Maria De Filippi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amici_di_Maria_De_Filippi "Amici di Maria De Filippi"), [Un'altra vita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Un'altra_vita "Un'altra vita"), and [Tutta colpa mia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tutta_colpa_mia "Tutta colpa mia")

In 2015, she competed in the [fifteenth edition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amici_di_Maria_De_Filippi#Season_15_(2015%E2%80%932016) "Amici di Maria De Filippi") of Italian talent competition series _[Amici di Maria De Filippi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amici\_di\_Maria\_De\_Filippi "Amici di Maria De Filippi"),_ and was selected as part of the white team, coached by [Emma Marrone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Marrone "Emma Marrone") and [Elisa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisa_(Italian_singer) "Elisa (Italian singer)"), placing second in the final, behind [Sergio Sylvestre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sergio_Sylvestre "Sergio Sylvestre").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:1-4) Shortly after the end of the show, Elodie signed with [Universal Music Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Music_Group "Universal Music Group") and released her debut single "[Un'altra vita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Un'altra_vita_(song) "Un'altra vita (song)")". The song peaked within the Top 40 in Italy, and was certified gold.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) The single was followed by her debut studio album, also titled _[Un'altra vita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Un'altra\_vita\_(album) "Un'altra vita (album)")_, which peaked at number two in Italy. The record was produced by Luca Mattioni and her former _Amici'_ s coach [Emma Marrone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Marrone "Emma Marrone"). To promote the album, the song "Amore avrai" was released as the second single. The song was nominated as "Song of the Summer" at [Radio 105 Summer Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radio_105 "Radio 105").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Elodie_album_peak_positions_in_Italy-6) From September to November 2016, Elodie served as an opening act during the Adesso Tour by [Emma Marrone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Marrone "Emma Marrone") and was featured in the benefit concert special _Amiche in Arena_, organized by [Loredana Bertè](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loredana_Bert%C3%A8 "Loredana Bertè") and [Fiorella Mannoia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiorella_Mannoia "Fiorella Mannoia").

In February 2017, Elodie was announced among the competitors of the [67th Sanremo Music Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanremo_Music_Festival_2017 "Sanremo Music Festival 2017"), with the song "[Tutta colpa mia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tutta_colpa_mia_(song) "Tutta colpa mia (song)")", written by [Emma Marrone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Marrone "Emma Marrone") and Oscar Angiuli. The song placed 8th during the final rank and peaked at number 12 on the Italian Singles Chart, being certified platinum.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:2-7)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Songs_authors-8)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) In the same month, the singer released her second studio album, _[Tutta colpa mia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tutta\_colpa\_mia "Tutta colpa mia")_, on 17 February 2017.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-9) The album peaked at number six on [FIMI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federazione_Industria_Musicale_Italiana "Federazione Industria Musicale Italiana")'s Chart, marking her second consecutive top 10 album.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-11) In April, the singer appeared as herself in the film _Non c’è campo_, directed by [Federico Moccia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federico_Moccia "Federico Moccia"), for which she also contributed to the soundtrack with the song "Semplice", featured on her album _Tutta colpa mia_. From May to June 2017, Elodie was featured as a special guest during the Scriverò il tuo nome Tour by [Francesco Renga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Francesco_Renga "Francesco Renga"). The two artists performed their collaboration "Così diversa" from Renga's first live album _Scriverò il tuo nome Live_.

### 2018–2019: Successful singles and collaborations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: 2018–2019: Successful singles and collaborations")]

In May 2018, Elodie released the single "[Nero Bali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nero_Bali "Nero Bali")", a collaboration with singer [Michele Bravi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michele_Bravi "Michele Bravi") and rapper [Guè](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gu%C3%A8 "Guè") as the lead single from her upcoming studio project.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-12) The song received widespread success, becoming the singer's first to reach the top ten of the Italian Singles Chart, at number 10.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-13) The song was promoted during the sixth edition of [Radio 105 Summer Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radio_105 "Radio 105"). Subsequently, it was certified double platinum.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) In October 2018 Elodie released the single "Rambla", featuring Italian rapper [Ghemon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghemon "Ghemon").

On 15 March 2019, Elodie collaborated with Italian pop band [The Kolors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Kolors "The Kolors") for the single "[Pensare male](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pensare_male "Pensare male")".[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-14) Within two weeks, it reached the top 10 of the Italian Airplay Chart and for three consecutive weeks it was the most played song on radio, the first time for both artists. The song was certified platinum in Italy.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-15)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) In June 2019, the collaborative single "[Margarita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margarita_(Elodie_song) "Margarita (Elodie song)")" with Italian rapper [Marracash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marracash "Marracash") was released.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-16) The song became one of the most successful songs of the summer in Italy, receiving three platinum certifications and peaking at number six on the Italian Singles Chart and number one on the Italian Airplay Chart.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-17)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) In September 2019, Elodie served as a member of the jury of the [Castrocaro Music Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Castrocaro_Music_Festival "Castrocaro Music Festival"), which aired on [Rai 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rai_2 "Rai 2"), hosted by [Stefano De Martino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stefano_De_Martino "Stefano De Martino") and [Belén Rodríguez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bel%C3%A9n_Rodr%C3%ADguez "Belén Rodríguez"). The following month, Elodie was featured in a re-recorded version of [Myss Keta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myss_Keta "Myss Keta")'s 2015 single "Le ragazze di Porta Venezia", subtitled "The Manifesto", with vocals by La Pina, [Joan Thiele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joan_Thiele "Joan Thiele"), [Roshelle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roshelle "Roshelle") and [Priestess](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Priestess_(rapper) "Priestess (rapper)"), included in the rapper's second studio album _Paprika_.

### 2020–2021: _This Is Elodie_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: 2020–2021: This Is Elodie")]

Main article: [This Is Elodie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/This_Is_Elodie "This Is Elodie")

In January 2020, it was announced that Elodie would compete during the [70th Sanremo Music Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanremo_Music_Festival_2020 "Sanremo Music Festival 2020") with the song "[Andromeda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andromeda_(Elodie_song) "Andromeda (Elodie song)")", written by [Mahmood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahmood_(singer) "Mahmood (singer)") and produced by [Dardust](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dario_Faini "Dario Faini"). The song debuted at number 35 after only two days on [streaming music services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Streaming_music_services "Streaming music services") and placed 7th at the end of the competition.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-18) On 7 January 2020, the singer announced her third studio album _[This Is Elodie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/This\_Is\_Elodie "This Is Elodie")_, which was released on streaming music services on 31 January 2020, and on [physical edition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CD "CD") on 7 February 2020 by [Island Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Island_Records "Island Records"). The album, described as [pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music") record, contained elements from [hip hop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_hop_music "Hip hop music"), [soul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soul_music "Soul music"), [funk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Funk "Funk") and [reggae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reggae "Reggae") and collaborations with [Guè](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gu%C3%A8 "Guè"), [Marracash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marracash "Marracash"), [Ernia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernia "Ernia"), [Gemitaiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemitaiz "Gemitaiz"), [Margherita Vicario](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margherita_Vicario "Margherita Vicario"), [Michele Bravi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michele_Bravi "Michele Bravi"), [Fabri Fibra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fabri_Fibra "Fabri Fibra"), [Lazza](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lazza "Lazza"), [Ghemon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghemon "Ghemon") and [The Kolors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Kolors "The Kolors"), as well as [Madame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madame_(singer) "Madame (singer)") in the streaming edition.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Rockol_review-19) The album debuted at number seven on the Italian Albums Chart.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:3-20) The week following the Sanremo Festival, both the album and the competing song "Andromeda" reached the sixth position of the relative FIMI charts.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Elodie_album_peak_positions_in_Italy2-21)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Italian_singles_chart-22)

On 13 May 2020, Elodie released the single "[Guaranà](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guaran%C3%A0_(song) "Guaranà (song)")", included in the digital re-issue of _This Is Elodie_, which was certified double platinum by FIMI for sales exceeding 140,000 copies.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-23)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-FIMI_singles_certifications-5) The following month she appeared as a featured artist on [Takagi & Ketra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takagi_&_Ketra "Takagi & Ketra")'s song "[Ciclone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ciclone_(song) "Ciclone (song)")", with [Gipsy Kings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gipsy_Kings "Gipsy Kings") and [Mariah Angeliq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mariah_Angeliq "Mariah Angeliq"), which became her fourth top 10 hit on FIMI's singles chart.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-25) In October 2020, Elodie was featured on [Carl Brave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carl_Brave "Carl Brave")'s single "Parli parli", included in the rapper's second studio album _Coraggio_.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-26)

On 30 December 2020, it was announced that Elodie would co-host the second night of the [71st Sanremo Music Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanremo_Music_Festival_2021 "Sanremo Music Festival 2021") alongside [Amadeus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amadeus_(presenter) "Amadeus (presenter)") and [Fiorello](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosario_Fiorello "Rosario Fiorello"). During the event, the singer performed a medley of her greatest success remixed with worldwide hits by [Beyoncé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beyonc%C3%A9 "Beyoncé"), [Raffaella Carrà](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raffaella_Carr%C3%A0 "Raffaella Carrà") and [Madonna](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madonna "Madonna").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:4-27) In January 2021, Elodie was cast on the second season of [Amazon Prime Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Prime_Video "Amazon Prime Video") reality competition show [_Celebrity Hunted Italia_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celebrity_Hunted "Celebrity Hunted"),[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:5-28) which she won, coupled with fellow musician [Myss Keta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myss_Keta "Myss Keta").[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-29)

### 2021–2023: _OK. Respira_, first arena tour and acting debut

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: 2021–2023: OK. Respira, first arena tour and acting debut")]

Main article: [OK. Respira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OK._Respira "OK. Respira")

In September 2021, Elodie released the song "[Vertigine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertigine "Vertigine")", as the lead single from her then upcoming fourth studio album, set for release in 2022. The song, an [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") ballad, was written by [Elisa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisa_(Italian_singer) "Elisa (Italian singer)") and peaked at number 40 on the Italian Singles Chart.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-30) On 5 October 2021, the singer appeared as a co-host during the season premiere of the twenty-fifth season of _[Le Iene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Le\_Iene "Le Iene")_. On 3 December 2021, Elodie collaborated with Italian rapper [Rkomi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rkomi "Rkomi") on "[La coda del diavolo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_coda_del_diavolo_(song) "La coda del diavolo (song)")", which topped the Italian singles chart and received five platinum certifications for sales exceeding 500,000 copies in Italy, marking the first number one single for Elodie.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-31)

On 3 March 2022, Elodie released "[Bagno a mezzanotte](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bagno_a_mezzanotte "Bagno a mezzanotte")" as the second single from her upcoming fourth studio album, which reached number 4 on the Italian Singles Chart.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-32) All proceeds from the single were donated to [Save the Children](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Save_the_Children "Save the Children") to help refugees from the [Russian invasion of Ukraine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine "Russian invasion of Ukraine").[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-33) On 10 June 2022, "[Tribale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tribale "Tribale")" was released as the third single from the album. The song, which reached number 13 on the Italian Singles Chart, marks the first official release in which Elodie provides songwriting credits.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-34)

In August 2022, it was announced that the singer would make her acting debut in the Italian film _[Burning Hearts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burning\_Hearts "Burning Hearts")_, directed by Pippo Mezzapesa. The film premiered in the [Orizzonti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orizzonti "Orizzonti") section of the [79th Venice International Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/79th_Venice_International_Film_Festival "79th Venice International Film Festival") on 3 September 2022. In the film, the singer played Marilena Camporeale, a [pentita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentito "Pentito") of the Gargano Mafia, which is based on a non-fiction book by Carlo Bonini and Giuliano Foschini and inspired by the true story of Rosa Di Fiore. Elodie's performance was met with critical acclaim which earned her a [Ciak d'oro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ciak_d'oro "Ciak d'oro") as "Revelation of the Year", a special award as "Best Breakthrough Performance" at [Bari International Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bari_International_Film_Festival "Bari International Film Festival") and a "Women in Cinema Award" at [Rome Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome_Film_Festival "Rome Film Festival").[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-35) Elodie also co-wrote and performed the original soundtrack of the film "[Proiettili (ti mangio il cuore)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proiettili_(ti_mangio_il_cuore) "Proiettili (ti mangio il cuore)")" with [Joan Thiele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joan_Thiele "Joan Thiele"). The song won the [David di Donatello for Best Original Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_di_Donatello_for_Best_Original_Song "David di Donatello for Best Original Song") as well as being nominated for a [Nastro d'Argento](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nastro_d'Argento "Nastro d'Argento") as Best Original Song.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-36)

On 4 December 2022, it was announced that Elodie would compete during the [Sanremo Music Festival 2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanremo_Music_Festival_2023 "Sanremo Music Festival 2023").[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-37) The song "[Due](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Due_(song) "Due (song)")" was later announced as her entry for the Sanremo Music Festival 2023.[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-38) On 9 December 2022, the single "[OK. Respira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OK._Respira_(song) "OK. Respira (song)")" was released ahead of her upcoming [album of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OK._Respira "OK. Respira"), which was released on 10 February 2023.[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-39) The album marked the singer's artistic development, combining [club-pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Club-pop "Club-pop"), [R&B](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contemporary_R&B "Contemporary R&B") and [electronic music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electronic_music "Electronic music").[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-40)[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-41)_OK. Respira_ peaked at number four of the Italian Albums Chart and became the first project by a female Italian artist to be certified platinum in 2023 by FIMI.[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-42) On 12 May 2023 Elodie performed at her first headlining arena show at [Mediolanium Forum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forum_di_Milano "Forum di Milano") in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan"), which anticipated her first arena tour, called Elodie Show 2023, starting the following November.

On 26 May 2023, Elodie released "[Pazza musica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pazza_musica "Pazza musica")", a collaboration with [Marco Mengoni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marco_Mengoni "Marco Mengoni"), which was included as a bonus track on _OK. Respira_ and as well as released as the second single from Mengoni's eighth studio album _[Materia (Prisma)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Materia\_(Prisma) "Materia (Prisma)")_.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-43) On 22 September 2023, she released the song "[A fari spenti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_fari_spenti "A fari spenti")" as the lead single from the [mixtape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mixtape "Mixtape")_Red Light_.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-44) The project was released as a surprise album without prior announcement. Its cover was drawn by [Milo Manara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milo_Manara "Milo Manara"). The record marked a departure from the singer's previous R&B and urban-influenced releases in favour of [house](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_music "House music"), [EDM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electronic_dance_music "Electronic dance music") and [techno](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Techno "Techno") influences.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-46) The proceeds were donated to the RED association, created by [Bono](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bono "Bono") to fund health programs for women in [Sub-Saharan Africa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sub-Saharan_Africa "Sub-Saharan Africa").[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-47) In November 2023, Elodie collaborated with Italian rapper [Sfera Ebbasta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sfera_Ebbasta "Sfera Ebbasta") for the song "Anche stasera", which served as the lead single from the rapper's fourth studio album _X2VR_.

### 2024–present: _Mi ami mi odi_ and first stadium show

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 2024–present: Mi ami mi odi and first stadium show")]

Main article: [Mi ami mi odi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mi_ami_mi_odi "Mi ami mi odi")

On 31 May 2024 Elodie released "[Black Nirvana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Nirvana "Black Nirvana")" as the lead single from her then upcoming fifth studio record. The song peaked at number 7 on the Italian Singles Chart and was certified platinum. During the summer, it was revealed that the singer will be featured on the new edition of the [Pirelli calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pirelli_calendar "Pirelli calendar"). In September, Elodie appeared as a featured artist in a remixed version of [Ornella Vanoni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ornella_Vanoni "Ornella Vanoni")'s song "Ti voglio", re-recorded with Vanoni and [Ditonellapiaga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ditonellapiaga "Ditonellapiaga"), included on the album _[Diverse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diverse\_(album) "Diverse (album)")_. On 8 November 2024, Elodie collaborated with Italian singer [Tiziano Ferro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiziano_Ferro "Tiziano Ferro") for the duet "[Feeling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feeling_(Elodie_and_Tiziano_Ferro_song) "Feeling (Elodie and Tiziano Ferro song)")", released as the second official single from her upcoming fifth studio album.[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-48)

The following month, she was announced among the competitors of the [75th Sanremo Music Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanremo_Music_Festival_2025 "Sanremo Music Festival 2025"),[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-49) where she placed 12th with the song "[Dimenticarsi alle 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dimenticarsi_alle_7 "Dimenticarsi alle 7")".[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-50) The song peaked at number 7 on the Italian Singles Chart and was certified gold. On 4 April 2025, Elodie released the song "[Mi ami mi odi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mi_ami_mi_odi_(song) "Mi ami mi odi (song)")", which anticipated her [fifth studio album by the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mi_ami_mi_odi "Mi ami mi odi"), released the following month. The record, a [pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music"), [electropop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electropop "Electropop") and [R&B](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contemporary_R&B "Contemporary R&B") record, peaked at number 3 on the Italian Albums Chart and was certified platinum. To promote the record, the singer embarked her first stadium tour, called The Stadium Show, which consisted in a two-dates event at [San Siro Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Siro "San Siro") in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan") and [Diego Armando Maradona Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stadio_Diego_Armando_Maradona "Stadio Diego Armando Maradona") in [Naples](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naples "Naples"). The two shows anticipated the following Elodie Show 2025, the second arena tour of the singer.

In the same year, Elodie was cast as Giada Costanzi in the [thriller film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thriller_film "Thriller film")_Gioco pericoloso_ and as Barbara in the [biographical drama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biographical_film "Biographical film") film _[Fuori](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuori "Fuori")_, directed by [Mario Martone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_Martone "Mario Martone") and based on 1983 novel _L'università di Rebibbia_ by [Goliarda Sapienza](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goliarda_Sapienza "Goliarda Sapienza"). For her role in _Fuori_, Elodie won her first [Nastro d'Argento for Best Supporting Actress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nastro_d'Argento_for_Best_Supporting_Actress "Nastro d'Argento for Best Supporting Actress").

In August 2025, Elodie was featured on [Irama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irama_(singer) "Irama (singer)")'s fifth studio album _[Antologia della vita e della morte](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antologia\_della\_vita\_e\_della\_morte "Antologia della vita e della morte")_ on the track "[Ex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ex_(Irama_song) "Ex (Irama song)")".

## Personal life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Personal life")]

Prior to joining _Amici di Maria De Filippi_, Elodie was engaged to DJ and producer Andrea Maggino.[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-51) During her participation on the show _Amici_ she met the singer [Lele](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lele_(singer) "Lele (singer)"). The two began a relationship in June 2016, which ended two years later.[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-52)

In the summer of 2019, after the release of the hit "Margarita", she started a relationship with the Italian rapper [Marracash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marracash "Marracash").[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-53) The couple split up in the winter of 2021.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-54)

In April 2026, Elodie revealed that she is in a relationship with Albanian dancer Françeska Nuredini.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-55)

## Music style and influences

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Music style and influences")]

In an interview on Fanpage.it Elodie affirms "I'm a girl born in a low-income housing project, that's why rap, naked and raw, is a good representation of where I grew up, and I like that." and cites young Italian rappers beba, [Chadia](https://it.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chadia%20Rodr%C3%ADguez "it:Chadia Rodríguez") and [Madame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madame_(singer) "Madame (singer)") as examples of "women of my generation who are not afraid to show this side. We are fierce."[[77]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-77) In an interview with _Rolling Stone Italy_, Elodie speaks about her influences: [Etta James](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etta_James "Etta James"), [Raf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raf_(singer) "Raf (singer)"), [Kaytranada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaytranada "Kaytranada"), [Nina Simone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nina_Simone "Nina Simone"), [Beyoncé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beyonc%C3%A9 "Beyoncé") and Italian singers [Giorgia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgia_(singer) "Giorgia (singer)"), [Mina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mina_(Italian_singer) "Mina (Italian singer)") and [Lucio Battisti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucio_Battisti "Lucio Battisti").[[78]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-78)[[79]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-79) She also cities _Amici'_ s coaches [Emma Marrone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Marrone "Emma Marrone") and [Elisa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisa_(Italian_singer) "Elisa (Italian singer)").[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-80) Her music is inspired by [pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music"), [R&B](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R&B "R&B"), [rap](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rap_music "Rap music"), [reggae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reggae "Reggae"), and [urban](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_music "Urban music") music.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-Rockol_review-19)

## Activism

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Elodie_(singer)&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: Activism")]

Elodie is an activist and supporter for the [LGBT rights in Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LGBT_rights_in_Italy "LGBT rights in Italy"), often siding against the right-wing party [Lega Nord](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lega_Nord "Lega Nord"), regarding the campaign to pass the Italian [anti-homophobia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anti-homophobia "Anti-homophobia") law.[[81]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-81)[[82]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-82) Following a speech given by [Giorgia Meloni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgia_Meloni "Giorgia Meloni"), leader of the [national-conservative](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_conservatism "National conservatism") party [Brothers of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_of_Italy "Brothers of Italy") (FdI), at the 2022 convention of the Spanish party [Vox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vox_(political_party) "Vox (political party)"), Elodie said when interviewed by Peter Gomez Homen: "It's not up to you, you're not God, you don't even come close. This is what disturbs me most about fascism. We can have different ideas, see life in a different way, but there is no need for all that animosity, that nastiness. ... It is easier to point and lash out at others for frustrations that do not concern the lives of others, but our way of life. It is much easier to lash out at black people, at gays."[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-83) After the [2022 Italian government crisis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Italian_government_crisis "2022 Italian government crisis"), Elodie took to her social media profiles to express her disappointment with the political programme of FdI.[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-84)

Elodie often points out that she was [discriminated](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discriminated "Discriminated") for her skin color and social status as a child, being a victim of [racism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Racism_in_Italy "Racism in Italy").[[85]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-85)[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-86)[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:7-87) She has also spoken out for [women's rights](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Women's_rights "Women's rights"), calling herself a [feminist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feminist "Feminist").[[88]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-88)[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elodie_(singer)#cite_note-:7-87)

Summer 2023 has witnessed [a slew of breakups,](https://english.elpais.com/society/2022-09-15/couples-beware-the-post-vacation-period-is-upon-us-and-its-the-most-dangerous-time-for-relationships-heres-why.html) and now another one is being added to the tally. On Tuesday, September 19, Italian singer Tiziano Ferro announced on social media that he has begun the “painful and delicate” process of divorcing his American husband, Victor Allen. The artist also explained that he will not be able to take his 2-year-old children to Italy, because there are numerous obstacles to parenthood for homosexual couples. “Some time ago, a painful separation began. I faced it in silence to protect everyone’s privacy. We recently started divorce proceedings in Los Angeles,” he wrote.

The post also stated that he cannot take his children to Italy, so he will stay with them in the United States. As a result, the singer has been forced to cancel the events in Italy for his book release. “It is a difficult moment during which all my attention is focused on the guardianship of my two wonderful children, who currently spend most of their time at home with me. At this time, I cannot leave them, and I cannot take them with me to Italy,” the singer noted in the statement. He added that he is suffering vocal cord problems; for that reason, Ferro’s doctor recommended that he cancel his last tour, but the singer did not do so. He ended the statement with a message to his fans: “I look forward to your understanding and continued support as I navigate this difficult time in my life.” Because his announcement was written, its exact tone is unclear. But in Italy, the post has been interpreted as [a denunciation of the bureaucratic obstacles homosexual couples face](https://english.elpais.com/international/2023-06-28/the-worldwide-offensive-against-the-rights-of-lgbtq-people.html)there.

Ferro and Allen met in 2016 at Warner Bros. Studios. Allen was working at the company as a consultant, and the Italian singer came to shoot a promotional video for one of his albums. Soon thereafter, the couple got married in Los Angeles and then in 2019 they celebrated their civil union in Sabaudia (same-sex marriage is not legal in Italy). Both Ferro and Allen had always expressed their desire to become parents, a dream that finally came true in 2022. In March of last year, they introduced Margherita and Andres, who were nine and four months old, respectively, at the time. The singer has never explained his children’s origins, nor has he said whether the babies came into the couple’s lives as newborns or when they were already a few months old. It is likely that they were born through surrogacy, a practice that is not allowed in Italy. “[The children], and only [the children], will decide if and when they want to share their story in public,” the singer said when he broke the news.

Last June, in an interview with _Grazia_ magazine, Tiziano Ferro slammed far-right Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s bill to criminalize surrogacy as “the umpteenth anti-homosexual decree.” He added that “they should at least have the nerve to be clear about it!” And he pointed out that gay couples who pursue surrogacy abroad have an easier time getting the parental rights of their children recognized in Italy, because “it is difficult for someone to ask how a child was born.”

The singer has always said that he wants his children’s rights to be recognized in Italy, but he refused to do so initially, because in order to register them with the Italian civil registry, he would have had to exclude Allen from the document and, for legal purposes, list himself as their sole parent.

“When I went to the Italian Consulate to register them at the civil registry, the form on which Victor’s name was excluded was like a slap in the face. So, I did not register them. Under these conditions that distort the reality of their existence in the world, they will not get an Italian passport,” he explained in the aforementioned interview. He went on to decry the situation: “If they are sick, only I can go to the emergency room [with them], because Victor is not on [their] passports, which is an abomination. Beyond agreeing or not, beyond morality or a manufactured sense of guilt, I have always thought that my rights do not detract from [the rights] of others.”

> [A post shared by Tiziano Ferro (@tizianoferro)](https://www.instagram.com/p/CxPeNFduge0/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)

In some countries, such as the United States, both parents’ names appear on a child’s birth certificate. But in Italy, it is not the practice to include both parents’ names on the birth certificate, and it is not recognized, either, which creates an uncertain legal situation for the child. If the child has a birth certificate that mentions the biological father, at least he has the possibility of being registered in the Italian civil registry, even if it is with only one legally recognized parent. Italian law does not allow homosexual couples to adopt, either. The country does allow a form of adoption for a couple’s child, but it is a long and complicated process.

As Vincenzo Miri, the president of the Lenford Network, a pro-LGBTQ rights organization, reminded the newspaper _La Stampa_, the singer’s children “have a foreign passport and according to the United States, they are unquestionably Tiziano and his husband Victor’s children, with all the rights…that this entails.” In a press release, Ferro’s lawyer requested that the media respect his client’s “privacy” at this moment in his life, “during which he will have to emotionally and legally handle the divorce, the matter of his children’s custody and…his expatriation.” The attorney added that Tiziano Ferro will also consider whether he wants his parental relationship to be recognized in Italy and whether he wants his children to acquire Italian citizenship.

Tiziano Ferro released his first album _Rosso Relativo_ [Relative Red] in 2001, and he has since become one of Italy’s most recognized voices. After a long career, in 2020 he decided to open up in the documentary _Ferro_, discussing how he fell into alcoholism and bulimia and had to hide his homosexuality because he saw it as an obstacle to his successful career.

Summer 2023 has witnessed [a slew of breakups,](https://english.elpais.com/society/2022-09-15/couples-beware-the-post-vacation-period-is-upon-us-and-its-the-most-dangerous-time-for-relationships-heres-why.html) and now another one is being added to the tally. On Tuesday, September 19, Italian singer Tiziano Ferro announced on social media that he has begun the “painful and delicate” process of divorcing his American husband, Victor Allen. The artist also explained that he will not be able to take his 2-year-old children to Italy, because there are numerous obstacles to parenthood for homosexual couples. “Some time ago, a painful separation began. I faced it in silence to protect everyone’s privacy. We recently started divorce proceedings in Los Angeles,” he wrote.

The post also stated that he cannot take his children to Italy, so he will stay with them in the United States. As a result, the singer has been forced to cancel the events in Italy for his book release. “It is a difficult moment during which all my attention is focused on the guardianship of my two wonderful children, who currently spend most of their time at home with me. At this time, I cannot leave them, and I cannot take them with me to Italy,” the singer noted in the statement. He added that he is suffering vocal cord problems; for that reason, Ferro’s doctor recommended that he cancel his last tour, but the singer did not do so. He ended the statement with a message to his fans: “I look forward to your understanding and continued support as I navigate this difficult time in my life.” Because his announcement was written, its exact tone is unclear. But in Italy, the post has been interpreted as [a denunciation of the bureaucratic obstacles homosexual couples face](https://english.elpais.com/international/2023-06-28/the-worldwide-offensive-against-the-rights-of-lgbtq-people.html)there.

Ferro and Allen met in 2016 at Warner Bros. Studios. Allen was working at the company as a consultant, and the Italian singer came to shoot a promotional video for one of his albums. Soon thereafter, the couple got married in Los Angeles and then in 2019 they celebrated their civil union in Sabaudia (same-sex marriage is not legal in Italy). Both Ferro and Allen had always expressed their desire to become parents, a dream that finally came true in 2022. In March of last year, they introduced Margherita and Andres, who were nine and four months old, respectively, at the time. The singer has never explained his children’s origins, nor has he said whether the babies came into the couple’s lives as newborns or when they were already a few months old. It is likely that they were born through surrogacy, a practice that is not allowed in Italy. “[The children], and only [the children], will decide if and when they want to share their story in public,” the singer said when he broke the news.

Last June, in an interview with _Grazia_ magazine, Tiziano Ferro slammed far-right Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s bill to criminalize surrogacy as “the umpteenth anti-homosexual decree.” He added that “they should at least have the nerve to be clear about it!” And he pointed out that gay couples who pursue surrogacy abroad have an easier time getting the parental rights of their children recognized in Italy, because “it is difficult for someone to ask how a child was born.”

The singer has always said that he wants his children’s rights to be recognized in Italy, but he refused to do so initially, because in order to register them with the Italian civil registry, he would have had to exclude Allen from the document and, for legal purposes, list himself as their sole parent.

“When I went to the Italian Consulate to register them at the civil registry, the form on which Victor’s name was excluded was like a slap in the face. So, I did not register them. Under these conditions that distort the reality of their existence in the world, they will not get an Italian passport,” he explained in the aforementioned interview. He went on to decry the situation: “If they are sick, only I can go to the emergency room [with them], because Victor is not on [their] passports, which is an abomination. Beyond agreeing or not, beyond morality or a manufactured sense of guilt, I have always thought that my rights do not detract from [the rights] of others.”

In some countries, such as the United States, both parents’ names appear on a child’s birth certificate. But in Italy, it is not the practice to include both parents’ names on the birth certificate, and it is not recognized, either, which creates an uncertain legal situation for the child. If the child has a birth certificate that mentions the biological father, at least he has the possibility of being registered in the Italian civil registry, even if it is with only one legally recognized parent. As Vincenzo Miri, the president of the Lenford Network, a pro-LGBTQ rights organization, reminded the newspaper _La Stampa_, the singer’s children “have a foreign passport and according to the United States, they are unquestionably Tiziano and his husband Victor’s children, with all the rights…that this entails.” In a press release, Ferro’s lawyer requested that the media respect his client’s “privacy” at this moment in his life, “during which he will have to emotionally and legally handle the divorce, the matter of his children’s custody and…his expatriation.” The attorney added that Tiziano Ferro will also consider whether he wants his parental relationship to be recognized in Italy and whether he wants his children to acquire Italian citizenship.

Tiziano Ferro released his first album _Rosso Relativo_ [Relative Red] in 2001, and he has since become one of Italy’s most recognized voices. ## Jessica Alba and Cash Warren, February 2025

One month after Jessica Alba and Cash Warren, who were married for 16 years, announced they had broken up, the _Honey_ actor officially filed for divorce [February 7, 2025].

In documents [obtained by _E! News_](https://www.eonline.com/news/1412245/jessica-alba-officially-files-for-divorce-from-cash-warren-after-16-years-of-marriage), Jessica – who shares three children with the film producer – Honor, 16, Haven, 13 and Hayes, 7 – asks for joint physical and legal custody of their kids. ## Lily Allen and David Harbour, February 2025

British pop icon Lily Allen and _Stranger Things_ actor David Harbour have reportedly split, after four years of marriage.

Multiple sources confirmed to _[People](https://people.com/lily-allen-david-harbour-separate-after-4-years-marriage-exclusive-sources-8383999)_ the couple's marriage has ended, however neither Lily or David have commented on the reports.

The couple met on celebrity dating app Raya and tied the knot in a Las Vegas ceremony in 2020. In December last year, Lily alluded to going through a "tough time" during her _Miss Me?_ podcast which she co-hosts with Miquita Oliver, which was impacting her mental health.

Here's hoping they're both doing ok during this difficult time.

## Jessica Alba and Cash Warren, February 2025

One month after Jessica Alba and Cash Warren, who were married for 16 years, announced they had broken up, the _Honey_ actor officially filed for divorce [February 7, 2025].

In documents [obtained by _E! News_](https://www.eonline.com/news/1412245/jessica-alba-officially-files-for-divorce-from-cash-warren-after-16-years-of-marriage), Jessica – who shares three children with the film producer – Honor, 16, Haven, 13 and Hayes, 7 – asks for joint physical and legal custody of their kids. The actor also cites "irreconcilable differences" as the reason for their split and lists December 27, 2024, as the official date of their separation.

## Lily Allen and David Harbour, February 2025

British pop icon Lily Allen and _Stranger Things_ actor David Harbour have reportedly split, after four years of marriage.

Multiple sources confirmed to _[People](https://people.com/lily-allen-david-harbour-separate-after-4-years-marriage-exclusive-sources-8383999)_ the couple's marriage has ended, however neither Lily or David have commented on the reports.

The couple met on celebrity dating app Raya and tied the knot in a Las Vegas ceremony in 2020. In December last year, Lily alluded to going through a "tough time" during her _Miss Me?_ podcast which she co-hosts with Miquita Oliver, which was impacting her mental health.

Here's hoping they're both doing ok during this difficult time.

## Fearne Cotton and Jesse Wood, December 2024

Fearne Cotton has announced that she and her husband, Jesse Wood, the son of Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood, have sadly split. The couple were married for 10 years, having first met in Ibiza in 2011.

Fearne took to her Instagram stories to share the news, writing: "It is with a heavy heart that I let you all know that Jesse and I are ending our marriage." The 43-year-old continued, stressing that their "priority has been, and will always be" their children, Rex, 11, and Honey, eight.

Fearne ended the post by asking for "privacy" and "respect" of her family at this time.

## Gyspy Rose Blanchard and Ryan Scott Anderson, March 2024

In news we weren't expecting today, Gypsy Rose Blanchard has announced she has split from husband Ryan Scott Anderson.

Gypsy shared the announcement on Facebook at the end of last week saying she needed time to focus on herself.

In a statement shared on Facebook and obtained by _[People](https://people.com/gypsy-rose-blanchard-announces-separation-from-husband-8621432)_, Gypsy said: "People have been asking what is going on in my life. Unfortunately my husband and I are going through a separation and I moved in with my parents home down the bayou. I have the support of my family and friends to help guide me through this. I am learning to listen to my heart. Right now I need time to let myself find… who I am."

The couple got married in July 2022 while Gypsy was in prison, and had met after Ryan began writing to Gypsy during the pandemic.

Following her release from prison earlier this year, Gypsy said she and Ryan were planning to have a second wedding ceremony to celebrate with their friends and family.

In 2016 Gypsy was sentenced to 10 years in prison for second degree murder of her mother Clauddinnea “Dee Dee” Blanchard. Throughout her childhood Gypsy Rose was the victim of her mother’s munchausen-by-proxy.

In the volatile world of [celebrity breakups](http://sheknows.com/tags/celebrity-breakups) and [celebrity divorces](http://sheknows.com/tags/celebrity-divorces), things can get nasty. Tweets get fired off, fingers get pointed, and at least one person is left with a broken heart. But what can make those splits even harder, is when kids are involved. We’ve seen plenty of contentious custody battles go on for years while the smear campaigns run rampant. We’ve seen [far too] many celebrities who pay more [child support](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/slideshow/2811584/most-expensive-celebrity-child-support-agreements/) in a month than plenty of people make in a year. (Can you _imagine_?!) We’ve seen celebrities who make co-parenting look easy and attainable. And we’ve seen celebrities who [“stole” their child](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/articles/2750471/christina-hall-stole-kids/) from their ex.

We’ve also seen plenty of celebrities who — for a variety of reasons — call things off before their child’s first birthday. In some cases, they do it before the baby is even born.

## Keke Palmer & Darius Jackson

There were public cries for Keke Palmer to leave boyfriend Darius Jackson in July 2023, less than five months after they welcomed their son Leodis “Leo” Andrellton. At the time, Jackson [publicly mom shamed _and_ sl*t shamed](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/slideshow/2803616/keke-palmer-boyfriend-darius-jackson-mom-shaming-comments/) Palmer for the outfit she wore to an Usher concert. Little did fans know, the disgusting display of male fragility and verbal abuse was just the tip of the iceberg.

Four months later, in Nov. 2023, Palmer requested an emergency restraining order against her ex and filed for sole legal and physical custody of baby Leo. In the heartbreaking documents, she revealed she had endured two years of physical, mental, and emotional abuse from Jackson. You can learn more about the gut-wrenching situation [here](https://www.sheknows.com/entertainment/articles/2890966/keke-palmer-darius-jackson-split/).

_If you’re in an emergency situation, call 9-1-1. If you or someone you love is dealing with an abusive person, you can contact the National Domestic Violence Hotline 1-800-799-7233 (TTY 1-800-787-3224) or find your state hotline [here](https://www.womenshealth.gov/relationships-and-safety/get-help/state-resources)._

## Neymar Jr.

About 6 weeks after welcoming their daughter, model Bruna Biancardi announced her breakup from soccer player Neymar Jr.

In [an Instagram story](https://www.hola.com/us/celebrities/20231129353157/bruna-biancardi-confirms-breakup-neymar/#:~:text=Bruna%20Biancardi%20has%20announced%20the,posted%20a%20story%20sharing%20it.) from Nov. 2023, she told followers this was a “private matter” but said she wanted to say she’s not in a relationship with anyone else “given my daily exposure to news, rumors, and jokes.”

“We are Mavie’s parents, and that is the reason for our bond,” she said. “I hope they stop linking me to news stories – about alleged cases of Neymar’s infidelity.”

Soon after, Neymar publicly admitted to cheating on Biancardi with influencer Fernanda Campos. “Bru, I’m doing this for you and your family. Trying to justify the unjustifiable. It wasn’t necessary, but I need you in our lives … I made a mistake. I was wrong.”

Despite the split, the soccer player — who also has a 12-year-old son from a previous relationship — said he “can’t imagine” life without Biancardi.

“All of this affected one of the most special people in my life. The woman I envisioned being by my side … I don’t know if it will work, but today I am certain that I want to try. Our purpose will prevail, our love for our baby will win.”

## Nick Cannon

Oh boy, let’s see if we can accurately get through this one. Even Nick Cannon’s brother Gabriel can’t successfully name his 12 nieces and nephews off the top of his head! “I’m not even gonna attempt,” [Gabriel said](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/articles/2837000/nick-cannon-family-cant-remember-kids-names/) in Sept. 2023.

Cannon has had multiple relationships end before his children’s first birthdays. The _Drumline_ star has 12 kids — one who tragically died in infancy from a brain tumor — with five women.

First, Cannon welcomed twins Moroccan and Monroe with his ex-wife Mariah Carey in 2011. The couple split three years later, after six years of marriage.

He then welcomed Golden Sagon in 2017 with ex Brittany Bell. Three years later, in 2020, the couple welcomed Powerful Queen.

Cannon welcomed twins Zion Mixolydian & Zillion Heir with ex Abby De La Rosa in 2021, and nine days later, he welcomed his late son Zen with ex Alyssa Scott.

In July 2022, he welcomed a son, Legendary Love with Bre Tiesi. Later that year, in September, he welcomed Onyx Ice with LaNisha Cole. That same month, he welcomed another son with Bell, Rise Messiah. Two months later, in Nov. 2022, he welcomed his daughter Beautiful Zeppelin with De La Rosa. One month later, he welcomed a daughter, Halo Marie, with Scott.

That’s a lot of babies and a lot of breakups (and make-ups!) to keep track of. As of Feb. 2024, Cannon was still dating Tiesi.

## Sherri Shepherd & Lamar Sally

Things got especially complicated with Sherri Shepherd and Lamar Sally. In 2014, when Shepherd and Sally’s surrogate was six months pregnant, Shepherd filed for divorce. The talk show host then fought to [keep her name off](https://www.sheknows.com/entertainment/articles/1111979/sherri-shepherds-ex-reveals-the-shocking-way-she-rejected-their-baby/)the baby’s birth certificate because a donor egg was used. Shepherd was successful in her plea and Lamar Jr. has been raised solely by Sally. Shepherd pays child support and Sally has unsuccessfully tried to [increase those payments](https://www.essence.com/news/watch-essence-black-women-in-sports-at-super-bowl-soulful-celebration/) in the past.

## Heidi Klum & Flavio Briatore

Model Heidi Klum and Formula One manager Flavio Briatore announced their relationship in March 2003. Klum then announced they were expecting in December, but the two [called things off](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-12437271/How-Leni-Klum-billionaire-businessman-Flavio-Briatore-rebuilt-fractious-father-daughter-relationship-years-never-seeing-adopted-Heidi-Klums-ex-Seal.html) before their daughter Leni was born in May 2004. Klum married her now-ex-husband Seal in 2005, and he adopted Leni soon after.

In 2016, [Briatore admitted](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-3708906/Heidi-Klum-s-ex-Flavio-Briatore-admits-no-longer-relationship-daughter-Leni.html) it’s “hard to miss” Leni given that he “never sees” her.

“Leni is my natural daughter, but the three of us happily agreed that it made more sense if Seal adopted her, because a child needs to grow up in a family,” he said. “…I know that Leni is not an abandoned child.”

Around the time of the breakup Brady met ex-wife Gisele Bündchen, with whom he shares kids Benjamin and Vivian.

## Mary-Louise Parker & Billy Crudup

As for Mary-Louise Parker and Billy Crudup, the _Almost Famous_ actor left a pregnant Parker for actress Claire Danes in 2003. In the volatile world of [celebrity breakups](http://sheknows.com/tags/celebrity-breakups) and [celebrity divorces](http://sheknows.com/tags/celebrity-divorces), things can get nasty. Tweets get fired off, fingers get pointed, and at least one person is left with a broken heart. But what can make those splits even harder, is when kids are involved. We’ve seen plenty of contentious custody battles go on for years while the smear campaigns run rampant. We’ve seen [far too] many celebrities who pay more [child support](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/slideshow/2811584/most-expensive-celebrity-child-support-agreements/) in a month than plenty of people make in a year. (Can you _imagine_?!) We’ve seen celebrities who make co-parenting look easy and attainable. And we’ve seen celebrities who [“stole” their child](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/articles/2750471/christina-hall-stole-kids/) from their ex.

We’ve also seen plenty of celebrities who — for a variety of reasons — call things off before their child’s first birthday. In some cases, they do it before the baby is even born.

## Keke Palmer & Darius Jackson

There were public cries for Keke Palmer to leave boyfriend Darius Jackson in July 2023, less than five months after they welcomed their son Leodis “Leo” Andrellton. At the time, Jackson [publicly mom shamed _and_ sl*t shamed](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/slideshow/2803616/keke-palmer-boyfriend-darius-jackson-mom-shaming-comments/) Palmer for the outfit she wore to an Usher concert. Little did fans know, the disgusting display of male fragility and verbal abuse was just the tip of the iceberg.

Four months later, in Nov. 2023, Palmer requested an emergency restraining order against her ex and filed for sole legal and physical custody of baby Leo. In the heartbreaking documents, she revealed she had endured two years of physical, mental, and emotional abuse from Jackson. You can learn more about the gut-wrenching situation [here](https://www.sheknows.com/entertainment/articles/2890966/keke-palmer-darius-jackson-split/).

_If you’re in an emergency situation, call 9-1-1. ## Neymar Jr.

About 6 weeks after welcoming their daughter, model Bruna Biancardi announced her breakup from soccer player Neymar Jr.

In [an Instagram story](https://www.hola.com/us/celebrities/20231129353157/bruna-biancardi-confirms-breakup-neymar/#:~:text=Bruna%20Biancardi%20has%20announced%20the,posted%20a%20story%20sharing%20it.) from Nov. 2023, she told followers this was a “private matter” but said she wanted to say she’s not in a relationship with anyone else “given my daily exposure to news, rumors, and jokes.”

“We are Mavie’s parents, and that is the reason for our bond,” she said. “I hope they stop linking me to news stories – about alleged cases of Neymar’s infidelity.”

Soon after, Neymar publicly admitted to cheating on Biancardi with influencer Fernanda Campos. “Bru, I’m doing this for you and your family. Trying to justify the unjustifiable. It wasn’t necessary, but I need you in our lives … I made a mistake. I was wrong.”

Despite the split, the soccer player — who also has a 12-year-old son from a previous relationship — said he “can’t imagine” life without Biancardi.

“All of this affected one of the most special people in my life. The woman I envisioned being by my side … I don’t know if it will work, but today I am certain that I want to try. Our purpose will prevail, our love for our baby will win.”

## Nick Cannon

Oh boy, let’s see if we can accurately get through this one. Even Nick Cannon’s brother Gabriel can’t successfully name his 12 nieces and nephews off the top of his head! “I’m not even gonna attempt,” [Gabriel said](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/articles/2837000/nick-cannon-family-cant-remember-kids-names/) in Sept. 2023.

Cannon has had multiple relationships end before his children’s first birthdays. The _Drumline_ star has 12 kids — one who tragically died in infancy from a brain tumor — with five women.

First, Cannon welcomed twins Moroccan and Monroe with his ex-wife Mariah Carey in 2011. The couple split three years later, after six years of marriage.

He then welcomed Golden Sagon in 2017 with ex Brittany Bell. Three years later, in 2020, the couple welcomed Powerful Queen.

Cannon welcomed twins Zion Mixolydian & Zillion Heir with ex Abby De La Rosa in 2021, and nine days later, he welcomed his late son Zen with ex Alyssa Scott.

In July 2022, he welcomed a son, Legendary Love with Bre Tiesi. Later that year, in September, he welcomed Onyx Ice with LaNisha Cole. That same month, he welcomed another son with Bell, Rise Messiah. Two months later, in Nov. 2022, he welcomed his daughter Beautiful Zeppelin with De La Rosa. One month later, he welcomed a daughter, Halo Marie, with Scott.

That’s a lot of babies and a lot of breakups (and make-ups!) to keep track of. As of Feb. 2024, Cannon was still dating Tiesi.

## Khloe Kardashian and Tristan Thompson

Khloé Kardashian and Tristan Thompson’s [tumultuous relationship](https://www.elle.com/culture/celebrities/a42712271/khloe-kardashian-tristan-thompson-relationship-timeline/) reportedly ended in February 2019, just under a year after their daughter True was born. There were multiple reports of infidelity, including Tristan “snuggling up” and “making out” with Jordyn Woods, Kylie Jenner’s best friend at the time.

A month later, Kardashian tweeted saying, “Tristan is equally to blame but Tristan is the father of my child … Honestly, Tristan cheating on me & humiliating me, wasn’t such a shock as [the first time](https://www.tmz.com/2018/04/10/tristan-thompson-cheating-going-to-hotel-woman-from-nightclub/)… What’s been harder & more painful is being hurt by someone so close to me. Someone whom I love & treat like a little sister. But Jordyn is not to be blamed for the breakup of my family. This was Tristan’s fault …”

## Grimes & Elon Musk

Grimes and Elon Musk have had quite the drama-filled time as parents. In 2020, they welcomed a son with the [highly-controversial name](https://www.sheknows.com/parenting/slideshow/2953333/celebrity-baby-name-controversies/) X Æ A-12. ## Sherri Shepherd & Lamar Sally

Things got especially complicated with Sherri Shepherd and Lamar Sally. In 2014, when Shepherd and Sally’s surrogate was six months pregnant, Shepherd filed for divorce. The talk show host then fought to [keep her name off](https://www.sheknows.com/entertainment/articles/1111979/sherri-shepherds-ex-reveals-the-shocking-way-she-rejected-their-baby/)the baby’s birth certificate because a donor egg was used. Shepherd was successful in her plea and Lamar Jr. has been raised solely by Sally. Shepherd pays child support and Sally has unsuccessfully tried to [increase those payments](https://www.essence.com/news/watch-essence-black-women-in-sports-at-super-bowl-soulful-celebration/) in the past.

## Heidi Klum & Flavio Briatore

Model Heidi Klum and Formula One manager Flavio Briatore announced their relationship in March 2003. Klum then announced they were expecting in December, but the two [called things off](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-12437271/How-Leni-Klum-billionaire-businessman-Flavio-Briatore-rebuilt-fractious-father-daughter-relationship-years-never-seeing-adopted-Heidi-Klums-ex-Seal.html) before their daughter Leni was born in May 2004. Klum married her now-ex-husband Seal in 2005, and he adopted Leni soon after.

In 2016, [Briatore admitted](https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-3708906/Heidi-Klum-s-ex-Flavio-Briatore-admits-no-longer-relationship-daughter-Leni.html) it’s “hard to miss” Leni given that he “never sees” her.

“Leni is my natural daughter, but the three of us happily agreed that it made more sense if Seal adopted her, because a child needs to grow up in a family,” he said. “…I know that Leni is not an abandoned child.”

Biography

 While enrolled at a neighborhood conservatory, Italian pop singer-songwriter Tiziano Ferro honed his craft by studying guitar and piano and sharpening his voice. At sixteen he entered a gospel ensemble, where his affinity for Afro-American sounds first took hold. By 1998 he had begun collaborating with producers Alberto Salerno and Mara Maionchi on his earliest compositions. EMI Italy issued his debut album, Rosso Relativo, three years later; it contained the hit single Xdono and established his reputation. Stardom arrived with the 2003 follow-up, 111—titled after the pounds he gained during a teenage struggle with bulimia—which ultimately surpassed a million copies sold. Although reviewers dismissed it as synthetic pop, Ferro built a thriving career both as a recording artist, collecting multiple platinum certifications and numerous awards, and as a writer for other performers such as Michael Bolton and Blue.  
  
 He cut tracks in Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, and English, most prominently the single Universal Prayer, a duet with British R&B star Jamelia that served as the official anthem for the 2004 Athens Olympic Games. A series of ill-considered remarks about Latin America on a television program in 2006 effectively ended his momentum there, yet the same controversy left his standing in Italy untouched; his subsequent releases, Nessuno è Solo (2006), Alla Mia Età (2008), and L’Amore È una Cosa Semplice (2011), each reached number one domestically. After years of silence, he publicly identified as gay in a 2010 Vanity Fair interview. In 2013 he produced the debut solo album by Italian rapper Baby K and contributed production work for Giusy Ferreri and Alessandra Amoroso. Late 2014 and early 2015 saw his greatest-hits collection TZN: The Best of Tiziano Ferro hold the top chart position for several weeks. Powered by fresh singles and a stadium tour, the set maintained strong sales through 2016.

Biography

 While enrolled at a neighborhood conservatory, Italian pop singer-songwriter Tiziano Ferro honed his craft by studying guitar and piano and sharpening his voice. At sixteen he entered a gospel ensemble, where his affinity for Afro-American sounds first took hold. By 1998 he had begun collaborating with producers Alberto Salerno and Mara Maionchi on his earliest compositions. EMI Italy issued his debut album, Rosso Relativo, three years later; it contained the hit single Xdono and established his reputation. Stardom arrived with the 2003 follow-up, 111—titled after the pounds he gained during a teenage struggle with bulimia—which ultimately surpassed a million copies sold. Although reviewers dismissed it as synthetic pop, Ferro built a thriving career both as a recording artist, collecting multiple platinum certifications and numerous awards, and as a writer for other performers such as Michael Bolton and Blue.  
  
 He cut tracks in Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, and English, most prominently the single Universal Prayer, a duet with British R&B star Jamelia that served as the official anthem for the 2004 Athens Olympic Games. A series of ill-considered remarks about Latin America on a television program in 2006 effectively ended his momentum there, yet the same controversy left his standing in Italy untouched; his subsequent releases, Nessuno è Solo (2006), Alla Mia Età (2008), and L’Amore È una Cosa Semplice (2011), each reached number one domestically. After years of silence, he publicly identified as gay in a 2010 Vanity Fair interview. In 2013 he produced the debut solo album by Italian rapper Baby K and contributed production work for Giusy Ferreri and Alessandra Amoroso. Late 2014 and early 2015 saw his greatest-hits collection TZN: The Best of Tiziano Ferro hold the top chart position for several weeks. Powered by fresh singles and a stadium tour, the set maintained strong sales through 2016.

Tiziano Ferro was born in Latina, Italy on February 21, 1980. He is one of the most famous and awarded Italian singer-songwriters. In 2001, he made his debut with his first single "Xdono", which climbed to the top of the Italian hit parade. In 2004, he won the Best Italian Artist award at the MTV Europe Music Awards. He has sold over 15 million records worldwide during his career. He is also famous in Latin America. He lives in Los Angeles with his husband, Victor Allen. They were married on June 25, 2019."

Italy

Tiziano Ferro is one of Italy’s most acclaimed and internationally recognised singer-songwriters. Tiziano Ferro

Italy

Tiziano Ferro is one of Italy’s most acclaimed and internationally recognised singer-songwriters. He debuted in 2001 with the single "Xdono" and the album "Rosso Relativo", quickly establishing himself as a defining voice in Italian and European pop. Over the years, he has released nine No. 1 albums and sold more than 20 million records worldwide, performing in Italian, Spanish, English, and Portuguese. Today he is known for timeless hits like "Sere Nere", "Imbranato", and "Non me lo so spiegare", and he has famously collaborated with artists such as Kelly Rowland, Mary J. Blige, and Sting. Tiziano Ferro won a prestigious MME Award in 2004.

Tiziano Ferro (born 21 February 1980 in Latina, Italy) is an Italian latin pop singer. He also records Spanish versions of his Italian albums and has had notable success in Europe and Latin America, Ferro has sold more than 7 million albums worldwide.

He is one of the most famous contemporary Italian musicians. His music is basically pop, with influences of rock, r&b and hip-hop or other music styles.His 2001's debut album, Rosso Relativo was characterized by a R&B/hip-hop flavor (although there was some controversy when the Italian satirical TV show Le Iene pointed out the similarity between his first hit single "Perdono" and a previous song by R.

Kelly called "Did You Ever Think"). The Spanish version of this album was called Rojo Relativo and fared very well throughout Spanish-speaking parts of the world. In late 2003, Ferro released his second album, 111 Centoundici.

It affirmed his place as one of Italy's top pop stars. In 2006 his third studio album Nessuno è solo was released and debuted at number one in Italy and Argentina. It debuted at #10 in Chile, and #11 in Spain.

The album was certified triple platinum. Tiziano released his new CD, titled Alla Mia Età in 2008.www.tizianoferro.com

Tiziano Ferro (born 21 February 1980 in Latina, Italy) is an Italian latin pop singer. He also records Spanish versions of his Italian albums and has had notable success in Europe and Latin America, Ferro has sold more than 7 million albums worldwide.

He is one of the most famous contemporary Italian musicians. His music is basically pop, with influences of rock, r&b and hip-hop or other music styles.His 2001's debut album, Rosso Relativo was characterized by a R&B/hip-hop flavor (although there was some controversy when the Italian satirical TV show Le Iene pointed out the similarity between his first hit single "Perdono" and a previous song by R.

Kelly called "Did You Ever Think"). The Spanish version of this album was called Rojo Relativo and fared very well throughout Spanish-speaking parts of the world. In late 2003, Ferro released his second album, 111 Centoundici.

It affirmed his place as one of Italy's top pop stars. In 2006 his third studio album Nessuno è solo was released and debuted at number one in Italy and Argentina. It debuted at #10 in Chile, and #11 in Spain.

The album was certified triple platinum. Tiziano released his new CD, titled Alla Mia Età in 2008.www.tizianoferro.com

The discography of Italian [pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music") singer and songwriter Tiziano Ferro consists of nine [studio albums](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_album "Studio album"), a greatest hits album, a [covers album](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Covers_album "Covers album"), one [video album](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_album "Video album"), 49 [singles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single_(music) "Single (music)") as lead singer, 15 singles as a featured artist and a [box set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_set "Box set").

The discography of Italian [pop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music "Pop music") singer and songwriter Tiziano Ferro consists of nine [studio albums](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Studio_album "Studio album"), a greatest hits album, a [covers album](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Covers_album "Covers album"), one [video album](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_album "Video album"), 49 [singles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single_(music) "Single (music)") as lead singer, 15 singles as a featured artist and a [box set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_set "Box set").
